raw.body:
## Goal

Developer settings gain an embeddings role, resolved through the Phase 1 provider adapters and routes; the adapter must declare an embed capability covering images and text in one space. With search.embedder set to route, search index and find become paid commands: a plan step forecasts the embeddings, one spend confirmation covers the request, and every call is reserved against the caps through the executor and journal. Resources and plan steps never call the hosted embedder: tree search paths and near matches use stored vectors only. The local SigLIP2 model stays the default. Each index records which embedder made its vectors and refuses another without a rebuild (design section 7.7).

## Why

Part of Phase 2 (asset management and search) of the 1.0 plan: [docs/PLAN.md](docs/PLAN.md#phase-2-asset-management-and-search), [docs/PRD.md](docs/PRD.md#phase-2-asset-management-and-search) and [docs/PRD-search.md](docs/PRD-search.md). Everything Assetgrove makes becomes a library a developer and their agent can browse, review, change and search.

## Acceptance

- With the embeddings role set to a scripted provider that declares embed, search index forecasts one call per unembedded image, asks for spend once, reserves each call in the ledger, and a repeat pays nothing twice.
- A route whose adapter lacks embed for images and text exits 2 route_unavailable before any reservation; init's data flows list the embedding provider.
- Indexing or querying an index built by another embedder exits 2 embedder_changed; search index --rebuild rebuilds it under the new embedder.
- With a hosted embedder, the tree's find and like paths and near matches make no provider call and use stored vectors only; find with words is a paid request with its own confirmation.
- A real check embeds a few images and one query through a hosted route within the release real-check budget, and is skipped offline.
- pnpm check, pnpm test and the package's commands pass.
- `pnpm check` and `pnpm test` pass.

## Context

- **Builds on Phase 1:** it is blocked by the Phase 1 gate and by the Phase 1 Objectives it names, which have merged before it starts.
- **Builds on** the Phase 2 Objectives this issue is blocked by.
- **Workflow files** under `.github/workflows/` are out of reach for this run; where one must change, the orchestrator changes it in its own PR.

## Decisions

The Phase 2 design decided these; this Objective builds to them. "Design section N" means the section quoted here. "Phase 1 #N" names the Phase 1 Objective a rule builds on. Where the design and the code disagree, the code's facts win and the run records the difference as an assumption.

### Standing rules

This brief states what holds when Phase 2 is done. Read it with the Phase 1 design, AGENTS.md, docs/decisions.md and the three PRDs. Phase 2 ends at release candidate 0.2.0 of `@clockgrove/assetgrove` and `@clockgrove/assetgrove-search`, which pass the gate; the owner publishes them.

Phase 1's standing rules hold. Phase 2 adds four:

- **Git is the record.** Cards, review records, indexes and logs are files in the game's repository, and every relation lives there. The search index is a projection that can be deleted and rebuilt.
- **Records first, projections second.** Provenance and review records are the records. Card machine fields, `index.md` and `log.md` are derived from them. Reason: a projection rebuilds and never says what the records don't.
- **Reading is a resource, changing is a tool.** Browsing and searching never pick, spend, edit or wait on a write.
- **Core works without search.** Core never imports the search package, LanceDB or Transformers.js, and the root install and root tests stay core-only. Reason: they are large and optional.

"Phase 1 #N" names the Phase 1 Objective a rule builds on.

### 7. The search package

`@clockgrove/assetgrove-search` lives in `packages/assetgrove-search/`. It has its own lockfile and tests, it is not part of the root install, and it versions with core.

- **CI:** a job that runs when the package's files change and installs the package alone, skipping the optional second onnxruntime-node and adding the platform's LanceDB binary. It is an orchestrator workflow change. The package peer-depends on core.

### 7.1 How it plugs in

- **Loading.** The extension contract (Phase 1 #181) gains an optional `search` slot. The package loads only when settings list it. Reason: installing a package loads nothing.
- **Commands stay core's.** Phase 1 doesn't let extensions add commands, so core declares `find`, `search index`, `search status` and `search setup` with `requires: "search"`. While the slot is empty:
  - help omits them;
  - the server lists neither their tools nor the search templates;
  - a call exits 2 `extension_unavailable`, naming the settings line.
- **Intel Mac.** On darwin-x64 the package refuses before import (`extension_unavailable`, reason `platform`). Neither LanceDB (since 0.23) nor onnxruntime-node builds for it.
- **What core supplies:** a library reader listing every indexable file (picks with card fields and text, bible references, run candidates, folders from settings) with size and mtime, loading one item on demand. Section 1's path rule and pointer handling apply.

### 7.2 Settings

Settings move to `assetgrove-settings/2` with an optional `search` block; `migrate` moves /1 forward (Phase 1 #163, #167).

```jsonc
"search": {
  "store": { "uri": "s3://bucket/prefix", "options": { "endpoint": "https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com", "region": "auto" },
             "credentialsEnv": { "accessKeyId": "AG_R2_KEY_ID", "secretAccessKey": "AG_R2_SECRET" }, "writer": true },
  "embedder": "local", "model": "siglip2-base", "candidates": true, "nearMatch": true, "folders": ["/abs/concept-art"]
}
```

- **The local store** is always `<stateDir>/search`. `store` adds a shared remote store.
- **Remote stores** accept `s3://`, `gs://` and `az://` URIs.
- **Only explicit options.** The URI, `options` and the credential variable names come only from settings. Lance gets exactly these, never credentials it discovers itself.
- **Refused variables.** Lance's object store also reads `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`, `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3`, `AWS_REGION`, `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`, `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, `AWS_SESSION_TOKEN`, `AWS_PROFILE`, `AWS_CONFIG_FILE`, `AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE` and `AWS_ALLOW_HTTP`. As a follow-up to the Phase 1 settings code (src/env.ts), they join the refused-environment list unless `environment.allow` lists them. Reason: no variable may redirect index data.
- **`writer: false`** makes a remote store read-only on this machine.

### 7.3 The adapter

Two interfaces inside the package keep vendors in one place:

- **Store.** It upserts, removes and queries rows (vectors, full text, filter, limit), and records what was built from what. The first store is LanceDB 0.41, pinned exactly.
- **Embedder.** It has an id, a pinned revision and a dimension, and embeds images and text. `siglip2-base` is the default. `scripted` is a deterministic embedder for offline tests.

**Model.** SigLIP2 base patch16-224 in ONNX through Transformers.js: image part fp32, text part int8, a 655 MB download.

- **Pinned.** The weights are pinned to a Hugging Face commit, and every file is checked against sha256 values the package ships.
- **Download.** `search setup` downloads them to `<stateDir>/models`. It tries the Hugging Face host first, then one fixed second mirror, a release asset of the project's repository. Both must match the same hashes.
- **Offline queries.** Queries run with remote models off.
- **Why:** best by words, within noise of CLIP by look; int8 text loses nothing, int8 image loses a lot. CLIP B/32's card puts deployed use out of scope, so it isn't offered.

**Schema.** One table per embedder and revision, with one row per image view:

| Column | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `tree` | sha256 of the work tree's real path, the key; the `game` id is kept for display |
| `id`, `address`, `source` | source: `pick`, `reference`, `candidate` or `folder` |
| `kind`, `subject`, `tags`, `state`, `bible`, `license` | card fields, filterable |
| `title`, `description`, `text` | `text` joins the card fields and body; full-text indexed |
| `path`, `sha256`, `view` | the media and its key frame or turntable view |
| `imageVec`, `textVec` | float32 × 768 |

- **`sources`** `(tree, path, size, mtimeMs, sha256)` drives freshness.
- **`vectors`** `(sha256, view, embedder)` caches image vectors by content. Reason: a branch switch re-embeds nothing seen before.
- **Indexes.** Scalar indexes cover `tree`, `source`, `kind` and `state`, and a full-text index covers `text`.
- **Vector search is exact and flat, without quantisation.** Reason: speed matters more than size, and flat search over 10,000 rows takes milliseconds.

**Concurrency.** The package owns its write lock, `<store>/write.lock`: an exclusive create holding the pid.

- One writer at a time; `optimize()` runs under the lock after a batch, never per upsert.
- A query never waits and never writes. While the lock is held, it answers from the current table with `fresh: false`.
- A missing `_versions` folder, found by stat, means rebuild.

### 7.4 Freshness

Before a query, unless another process holds the write lock, the indexer stats the tree's indexable files, compares them with `sources`, hashes only changed files, takes vectors from the cache and embeds only unseen content, and drops rows for files that are gone. This catches branch switches, pulls and hand edits. Deleting the store is safe: the next query rebuilds it, with progress. The server keeps the model and tables open between queries, for speed.

### 7.5 Find

`find [words] [--like <address|path>] [--where <filter>] [--source …] [--game all] [--limit n] [--outliers <set>]` (tool `find`, read-only).

- **Words:** Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k = 60) over three rankings against the query's text embedding:
  - the image vector;
  - the card-text vector;
  - full text.
- **Look:** the image vector against the query image. Words and an image together fuse all lists.
- **Where:** `field=value`, `!=`, `<`, `>` and `tag=value` over a fixed field list, compiled to escaped literals; an unknown field exits 2 `invalid_input`. A filter string never reaches SQL unparsed.
- **Results** keep the best view per asset: `hits: [{address, rank, score, source, fields}]`, with card text under `sharedText`, plus `fresh` and `builtFrom`. A numbered sheet comes as image content, numbers only. Reason: Phase 1 sheets carry no shared text.
- **Scope.** The current work tree by default; `--game all` searches every tree in the store. `search.candidates: false` leaves candidates out.
- **Outliers:** each member of a set gets its mean cosine distance to its five nearest neighbours in the set, as a robust z-score. Members with z > 3 are listed. Advisory and free.

### 7.6 Near matches before paid generation

With search loaded and `search.nearMatch` on, the plan step of `plan`, `stage`, `apply` and `generate-sheet` (Phase 1 #173) looks for picked assets of exactly the spec's kind and subject.

- **With references,** a match must also clear the image-similarity threshold measured by the bench. That number ships in the search package. **Without references,** same-kind, same-subject picks are listed, ranked by words.
- **Output.** Up to three matches go into `WorkPlan.nearMatches` with a sheet, and the spend form lists them.
- **The digest** leaves them out. Reason: a changing index mustn't void a confirmation.
- **Failure.** A failed search records `searchError`, and the plan goes on.

### 7.7 Hosted embeddings

A developer may embed through a provider's API instead of the local model. SigLIP2 stays the default.

- **Route.** `search.embedder: "route"` uses the `embeddings` role in developer settings, resolved like every role (Phase 1 #170). The adapter must declare the `embed` capability for both images and text in one space (Phase 1 #181); otherwise exit 2 `route_unavailable`. Each key goes to its provider's fixed host, and `init`'s data flows name the provider that receives the images (Phase 1 #189).
- **Spend.** Embedding calls are paid calls. `search index` and `find` become paid commands with a plan step that forecasts the images and queries to embed, one spend confirmation, and reservations against the caps through the executor and journal (Phase 1 #166, #173, #174, #180, #183). Re-indexing reuses journalled vectors and pays nothing twice.
- **No spend from reads or plan steps.** With a hosted embedder, the tree's `find` and `like` paths and near matches use only vectors already in the index; a words query needs the `find` tool. Reason: resources and plan steps never spend.
- **One embedder per index.** Every table records the embedder id, route and model that made its vectors. Indexing or querying with a different embedder exits 2 `embedder_changed` until `search index --rebuild` rebuilds that index.
- **Tests stay lean.** Offline tests use the scripted provider's embed capability; one real check per release embeds a few images and a query within the real-check budget.

### 7.8 Shared index

- **Through the team's own bucket only.** Assetgrove offers no hosted index service.
- **What a remote store holds:** pick and reference rows only, built from a clean HEAD (no changes under the library root). It carries card fields, text, paths and embeddings, never images. Candidate and folder rows stay in the local store. A query searches both and fuses the results.
- **One writer.** One machine has `writer: true`. A reader whose HEAD differs from the remote's `builtFrom` reports `fresh: false`. Reason: Lance doesn't enforce conditional writes.
- **Notice.** `init` says that a shared index exposes embeddings to whoever can read the bucket.

### 7.9 Bars

The owner has confirmed these bars, and they are committed to docs/decisions.md before the measuring run. Quality bars are the spike's measured values minus two standard errors, rounded down to 0.05. Speed bars are measured on the 24-thread reference box.

| Measure | Bar | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| By look: ≥ 3 of top 5 share category | ≥ 0.85 | dispatch |
| By look: recall@10, same pack and category | ≥ 0.65 | dispatch |
| By look: 16-px pixel art | ≥ 0.50 | dispatch |
| By words P@5: image vector only | ≥ 0.45 | dispatch |
| By words P@5: shipped mode | ≥ 0.85 | dispatch |
| Filters return only matching rows; rebuild gives identical results | 100% | test |
| Text query p95 / image query p95 | ≤ 150 / 500 ms | reference box |
| Search over 10,000 assets, fresh | < 1 s | reference box |
| Indexing | ≤ 150 ms per image | reference box |
| Freshness, no changes, 2,000 files | ≤ 100 ms | reference box |

- **The labelled library** is about 300 images, a subset of the spike's 1,733 CC0 images stratified across every category and pack, with enough 16-px pixel art for its own measure. It lives under `bench/search/`; the bench fetches the images and never commits them. The manifest holds pinned addresses and sha256 values, labels, look queries, 30 written queries, same-asset pairs and a card text per image.
- **Written card text.** The spike measured shipped mode with card text derived from file names, which inflates it. The gate's card texts are written from the images by a vision model, spot-checked by a person, with the model, prompt, date and spot-check sample recorded.
- **Precision.** At about 300 images each quality measure is precise to roughly ±0.05. The bars keep the spike's values and are read with that margin; a miss within it is re-run once on the reference box before it counts.
- **Unmeasured int8.** The int8 text part is unmeasured on card vectors. If shipped mode fails on it, the text part goes to fp32.
- **The image-similarity threshold** comes from the same bench: the similarity at which labelled same-asset pairs reach precision 0.9.

raw.body:
This issue is how the coordinator reaches agents that work on this repository from outside (cloud agents and other long-running workers). **If you are such an agent: read the newest comments here at every task boundary and before you open or update a pull request.**

How it works:
- The coordinator posts steering as comments. A line that starts with your lane name is for you (for example `rust-cloud:`); a line that starts with `all:` is for everyone.
- You answer with a short comment that starts with your lane name: what you did, the PR number and head, what is next, and any question. One comment per task boundary, not per step.
- Your goal lives in its own issue; this board only carries changes of direction, decisions and answers.

Standing rules for every lane:
- Small pull requests against main (aim under about 1,500 changed lines), branched from current main, opt-in or default-off until complete, each building and testing on its own.
- Normal merges only: no rebase of pushed branches, no force-push. Never push to a pull request that is in the merge queue; follow-ups go in a new small PR. Never merge your own PR.
- Drafts until your checks are green, then mark ready. Read the automated review comments on your PRs and answer each one.
- No secrets, no real API calls and no real sign-in in tests or CI. Never weaken a scanner or a security check, and never split strings to get past one.
- Commit identity: the repository's configured no-reply identity only.
- No users yet: no legacy names, no migration paths, port or build current behaviour only.
- Stay inside your lane's paths; if you need a change elsewhere, ask here.

根拠と設計：PR #106 の docs/seo-six-sites-audit-20261019.md。正式基準はrun39187166837（確定09-18〜10-15、218表示4クリック）。query×pageと他5サイトの現在インデックス状態は未取得のため原因を確定しない。

- [x] mainでDiscovery Diagnosticsを手動実行。run39226612662で6サイトREADY、17 URLのAPI取得成功。16 URL登録済み・食品pack-riceはGoogle未認識。
- [x] 初回本番確認後、診断workflowのschedule欠落も既存gsc_schedule_healthに追加。マージ前の予定日を欠落と扱わず、初回対象週を記録。既存集計は24時間猶予付き監視をPR #106で追加。
- [x] 新鮮なartifactだけ受入（期間/プロパティ/SHA、10日超UNKNOWN）。NO_ROWS/欠落/失敗を0扱いしない。検索語内訳はサイト合計に加算しない。
- [x] 低標本抑制案：28日前期間100表示以上・現在期間はOBSERVEDの確定値（実測0を含む）・減少50%以上かつ50以上、7日前週50以上・減少30以上。2回継続で候補。運用閾値であり統計的有意差ではない。
- [x] ページの11〜20位、28日30表示以上を調査候補。検索語が匿名化なら意図は未確認。非登録/異常はOBSERVED_SNAPSHOTと公開HTTP/クロールを照合。
- [x] 日用品：ティッシュ10箱以下なし、洗剤の最安/普段/まとめ買いが同一6袋。既存STEP5の候補取得・厳格な数量/送料/用途判定で不足を検査し、基準を緩めずに補充可能か調べる。
- [x] 同一期間GA4のテスト/不明を分離し、既存PV30等の導線ゲートを再利用。GSCと個人行動を結合しない。楽天確定報酬は非公開STEP7。
- [x] 誤検知・6サイト混在・古い結果・API403/429・権限/欠測・初回scheduleをテスト。最初は既存Issue/診断レポートのみ。

効果未確認のSEO文言/商品を自動公開せず、根拠付きPRで検証し、ユーザーのマージ許可に基づいて安全確認後にマージ。新規ページ大量生成、無条件title変更、main自動マージなし。

設計補正：監査書の初期案「前後各100表示以上」は採用しない。現在期間の最低100表示条件を置くと、急減して0〜99表示になった重要事象を見落とすため。前期間の最低件数と現期間の取得成功を条件にし、実測0とNO_ROWS/UNAVAILABLEを分離する。

## 2026-10-19 18時台：本番実測による更新
- 新診断 run39226612662、artifact12173997874（SHA256 a7d0f5e4a81ab74437dce54126ed8624dd59ba66a1c58d3e42a2187675dce59e）。確定窓09-19〜10-16。午前の既存集計09-18〜10-15とは窓が1日違うため合算・単純な成果比較をしない。
- 17 URLの取得成功、16 URLがPASS/Submitted and indexed・Google/指定canonical一致。食品 `/categories/pack-rice/` はNEUTRAL/URL is unknown to Googleでクロール・canonical情報なし。公開200とGoogle未認識は区別できた。URL Inspectionは保存済み状態でライブテストではない。
- ベビー・ペット・SOTOJITAKUの返却検索語はsite:github.ioのみ。匿名化で省略される語は不明。平均順位25/31等を「おむつ最安値」「ペットシーツ比較」の順位として評価しない。
- 日用品では「ティッシュ どこが安い」→tissue（9表示・10.11位）、「洗濯洗剤 安い」→laundry（5表示・28.6位）等の自然語×ページを取得。無関係なsite:検索によるトップページ表示と購入候補を分けて診断する。
- ボードゲームの2人用ページは自然語10行を取得し、主に62〜99位。ベビー等より商用検索の入口に根拠があるため、日用品に次ぐ改善調査候補へ優先度を更新。ただし少数で効果は未判定。
- ベビーMとボードゲーム2人用の最終クロールは10-08 UTC。10-12の比較入口改修後の再クロールはこのスナップショットでは確認できない。改修失敗とは結論しない。
- 新監視 run39226794961 が本番でHEALTHY。既存schedule run39198475008を正しく認識し、手動成功を代用しなかった。

### 自動診断の追加条件（設計）
- 検索演算子site:付きの行を確認検索、その他を自然語の返却行として別表示する。運営者・ボットとは断定しない。公式のサイト合計は改変しない。内訳は省略があるので自然語の全流入数・購入率に換算しない。
- 食品pack-riceの既存内部リンク・sitemap・公開状態を照合し、Google未認識の原因を断定せず継続観察。根拠なくsitemap再送やページ量産をしない。


追検証：食品トップと米カテゴリーにはpack-riceへの通常のHTMLリンクが各1本あり、公開sitemapにも正規URLを確認。単純な内部リンク欠落・sitemap未掲載をGoogle未認識の原因とする根拠はない。リンクやsitemapを作り直さず、Google側の発見/再クロールを診断レポートで継続確認する。

## 運用権限の更新（2026-10-19）
ユーザーより今後のマージを許可された。通常の修正はエージェントが変更内容・テスト・CI・競合を確認し、PR経由のマージと本番確認まで進める。ユーザーへコードレビューを毎回依頼しない。大規模SEO変更、公開商品データの大幅変更、未解決の不具合・重大な方針判断は引き続き別扱いとする。

## 2026-10-19 STEP8 本番実装完了

PR https://github.com/stusaurus/daily-cost-jp/pull/109 を通常の許可済み変更としてsquash merge。main `ee280401cc6a26cca5e38fd89216e3e088bfe143`。別の運営Issue/PR生成器/監視workflowは追加していません。

### 検証結果
- 最新headの6 CIが全成功。全体検証 run39250102560 では実商品ビルド・全品質ゲート・1440/390/320px保護機能・検索購入導線・Lighthouseの全steps成功。Python477件、Node113件、公開財務境界チェック成功。
- main既存運営実行 https://github.com/stusaurus/daily-cost-jp/actions/runs/39251605110 成功。公式aggregate/discoveryの両sourceがFRESH。aggregateはschedule run39198475008/as_of10-18 と既存run38554023648/as_of10-14、diagnosticはrun39226612662/as_of10-19を別期間のまま保持。
- 既存rolling Issue https://github.com/stusaurus/daily-cost-jp/issues/74 の更新成功を `operations-issue-sync.json: UPDATED` で確認。単一Issueを維持。STEP2本番結果 `NO_SAFE_FIX`、recipe=nullで不要なDraftを作成せず。新しいGSC/商品構成候補は調査専用であり、無条件の無人マージは追加していません。
- 既存監視のmain手動テスト https://github.com/stusaurus/daily-cost-jp/actions/runs/39251670848 成功。集計は本物のschedule run39198475008を参照してHEALTHY。診断は10/26 09:45 JSTを初回としNOT_YET_DUE。手動GSC成功を定期成功の代用にしていません。
- 公開ビルド https://github.com/stusaurus/daily-cost-jp/actions/runs/39251605089 はbuild/deploy/公開PC・スマホ監査成功。X投稿はpush実行のため既存仕様通りskip（投稿・設定の変更なし）。公開build-info.jsonのcommit/run_id一致を確認。
- 公開ティッシュ案内を実データと再照合：5箱・送料込み1,050円・100組116.67円・楽天リンク/商品ID/金額/用途属性一致。「候補なし」の誤表示解消。既存購入枠はALLOW_FIXED_SELECTION/FIXED_SELECTION_ALLOWED。商品データや価格計算、ランキング判定、安全基準を手動で変更していません。

### 検出結果と次の対象
- 193対219表示の減少は急減閾値に該当しない。日用品の洗剤/紙の11〜20位候補は別基準日の既存記録にもありP2。低CTRは仮説であり改善効果の証明ではない。
- 食品pack-riceは最初の保存済みNEUTRAL/PUBLIC_HTML観測としてP3。未取得やHTTP404と区別し、根拠なく再構築/再送しない。
- STEP5には3カテゴリとも数量別の安全な候補があり、空枠0。朝の「取得候補そのものがない」という判断は現在の全候補には適用しない。一方、旧おすすめ欄の同一商品のロール重複を3カテゴリで再現・自動検出。
- GSC09-19〜10-16とGA4九月20〜10月17は別窓。cross_source_periods_match=falseで導線統合を保留。operator区分は登録済みだが、比較可能なイベント標本は不足。確定成果未接続は0円ではなく不明、非公開境界を維持。
- 投資は日用品の既存3ページを最優先、次にボードゲーム2人用の自然語/比較情報/再クロール調査。食品はGoogle認識の継続監視。ベビー/ペット/SOTOは自然な購入関連語の露出が未確認で大量改修しない。3〜6位のROI優劣は未確定。

### 残る項目（未検証を完了扱いにしない）
- [ ] 2026-10-26の初回診断schedule実績確認。既存gsc_schedule_healthが24h猶予後の未実行/失敗を監視。GitHub基盤全体停止と個人通知設定に依存する限界は残る。
- [x] 旧おすすめ欄とSTEP5数量別枠のロール重複を、既存選定の再利用と保護テストを前提に整理する。商品判定を緩めない。
- [x] 既存pilotと公式診断の別期間の低CTR仮説について、値を混合せず運営Issue内の同義項目の表示を整理する余地。
- [ ] 十分な同条件の観測と非公開確定成果で改善効果を評価。今回の売上増加・SEO効果は未証明。新候補からの無人マージは未導入。

追加のユーザーGitHub操作は現時点では不要。通常修正のマージを毎回人へ依頼せず、既存のテスト/CI/安全境界を確認して進める方針は維持。

PR https://github.com/stusaurus/daily-cost-jp/pull/110 を全CI・競合・差分確認後にsquash merge。main `57d968c9539bfdbf6a3d967880cd91da1b09a261`。
